claim: She switched to third-person multiple viewpoint in Liveship only because important events happened at once in different places.

Simultaneity is the only reason the page gives for the switch, so the claim's 'only' stands; note the page also cites a second benefit (multiple perspectives on one event) as a consequence, not a cause.

Page names the Fellowship/LOTR rather than Tolkien by name.
